newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: First National to buy N. Ireland branches of C&G.
newsitem.headline: First National to buy N. Ireland branches of C&G.

text.p: Ireland's First National Building Society said on Monday that it is acquiring the Northern Ireland branch business of Cheltenham & Gloucester which has total assets in excess of 70 million stg.
The acquisition will treble the size of First National's Northern Ireland operations and strategically improve its presence there, First National said in a statement.
"This is an important strategic acquisition for First National. Group strategy is to develop critical mass in the UK as well as in Ireland," First National managing director John Smyth said.
The completion of the transfer of the Northern Irish business will take place on December 31 and it will be integrated with First National's operations in Northern Ireland.

The Irish building society said it had funded the acquisition from within its own internal resources and the impact of the acquisition on liquidity and capital adequacy would be minimal. It plans to complete the purchase without recourse to external advisors.
It did not say how much it paid for the business.
